verdict.rationale: Docs confirm full/scheduled exports produce human- and machine-readable files, with properties as Markdown front matter and collections as CSV, explicitly for reuse in other apps or programmatic work, plus automated export scheduling and offline-first local access. This directly supports archive portability beyond the vendor, though there's no independent/third-party verification of export fidelity or long-term format stability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of export completeness/fidelity and any documented full raw-data JSON export beyond CSV/Markdown.
